prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
Early pre-dawn morning, transitioning into first light. An athlete sits on the edge of a low concrete step or worn wooden bench outdoors — the ground beneath is cool pavement, faintly damp. Time of day: 5:30 AM, just before sunrise. The world is still, charged with quiet intention.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No product. The sneaker — a low-profile athletic trainer, laces mid-tie — is the sole visual anchor. The hand gripping and threading the lace occupies the center of the frame. Nothing else competes.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
Extreme close-up of a single human hand, fingers actively pulling a lace taut on the left sneaker. Knuckles slightly tensed, natural skin texture visible — faint vein definition on the back of the hand, no over-smoothed retouching. Fingernails clean and unpolished. The wrist and forearm fade softly into shallow depth of field. No face, no full body — presence implied through gesture alone.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Blurred background suggests an empty street or running path at first light — faint streetlamp glow halos softly out of focus. The toe of the sneaker rests on rough concrete with visible aggregate texture. A thin layer of cool morning mist implied in the atmospheric depth. No props, no accessories, no clutter — absolute editorial restraint.

[LIGHTING]
45° camera-left, motivated practical light from a distant streetlamp at 3200K tungsten blending with the first ambient skylight at 6500K overcast-dawn — producing a cool-warm split across the hand: warm amber catching the knuckles and lace, cool blue-grey falling across the sneaker toe and concrete. Large softbox diffusion quality on the fill side. Shadow behavior: soft falloff with gradient transition across the hand, contact shadow only at base where sneaker meets ground.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 100mm macro, aperture f/2.8, extremely shallow depth of field. Tack-sharp focus on the lace-knot and the first two fingers pulling tension. The sneaker midsole and background dissolve into smooth bokeh. Frame is intimate and compressed — nothing beyond the hand and shoe exists in sharp reality.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Resolute and still. Pre-action silence. The kind of quiet that exists only in the minute before commitment becomes motion. Air quality: cool, slightly humid, urban morning. No nostalgia — forward-facing, purposeful tension.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Desaturated cool slate and concrete grey as the dominant field. Warm 3200K amber accent raking across skin and lace. Muted white of the sneaker upper as the lightest tonal anchor. Low saturation overall — no punchy color, no lifestyle-brand brightness.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Cass Bird, Jamie Hawkesworth, Nadav Kander. Editorial commercial photography.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic skin and fabric textures, natural hand details — visible pores, knuckle creases, lace tension physically believable. Grain structure consistent with 35mm film stock pushed to ISO 800.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible brand logos or text on sneaker, no typography of any kind anywhere in frame.

resolution: 2k
